name: smwmusic-madou-monogatari-hanamaru-dai-youchienji-last-battle
title: Madou Monogatari: Hanamaru Dai Youchienji - Last Battle
description:
A short moderately paced final boss theme with a couple of time signature changes to change the beat up. This plays during the fight with the dreaded Fudoushi who's under possession by the character known as "Devil".
The B Section of this song is one long legato so it would be recommended to have pausing disabled for this song, or have a work-around that doesn't disable voices.
